title: Hearth of Ember
shortDescription: Banked coals keep a copper grate honest.
longDescription:
The Hearth of Ember smells of soot, warm metal, and the ghost of last night's oatcakes left too near the coals. A copper grate holds a low fire that does not waste itself. Tongs hang in a row, blackened at the tips. Clay pots of sand wait for the lesson that comes after a spark gets ideas.
Mentor Cinder stands where the heat is useful, not where it is pretty.
A straw hearth dummy stands where a lesson can be finished without guessing.

fixtures.name: Mentor Cinder
fixtures.lookDescription: A soot-stained stoat in a leather apron, copper-bright eyes, tongs at the belt. Try talk cinder.
fixtures.examineDescription: Cinder's whiskers are singed at the tips. The apron is older than most first-years and smells of honest smoke. She treats fire as a tool that will bite the careless and feed the careful.
fixtures.dialogue: Cinder has the grate open and a low fire working in it. "Ember is fire kept in a grate and not up in the rafters. That is the whole difference, and it takes three lessons to learn." She nods at the straw dummy in the corner. "Talk cinder when you are ready to start."

welcome.text: "The grate ticks, and last night's oatcakes were left too near the coals again. Look around this hearth. Name the fire before you feed it. Then attack the hearth dummy in here, mine and not the one Flint keeps out in his orchard, unless you are still learning the spark on his. Come back and talk to me. I will open this School's leaf and ink its stem."

craft.text: "The Field Primer is your book, not a decoration. I open this School's leaf and ink the stem after you look around this hearth, defeat the dummy, and talk to me. Later the Primer holds ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name. Do not skip the dummy. Fire that is not named will bite."

go.text: "Look around this hearth. Defeat the dummy. I will be here by the grate. The tongs stay hot. So do I."

lessons-done.text: "The stem is inked. Cast ember at the hearth dummy for the second lesson — a sheltered coal, not a show. After that, the Primer holds one ink. Open the book and type ink and the vein's name."

third-lesson.text: "The grate is shut and the tongs are on their nail. Talk to Headmaster Alder in the High Study, up from the Great Hall. If he has you on that Clock Tower stair, finish it first. When he says the grounds will teach the rest, come back and talk to me."

third-done.text: "This hearth has nothing left to teach you, and I am not going to invent a fourth lesson to keep you here. Each lesson off the grounds leaves one ink in the Primer. I sign the page whether I am standing at your shoulder or not." She checks the grate out of habit. "Keeper Holm kept a stair lit so first-years would not walk it in the dark. Eat something warm before you walk a cold road."

fixtures.name: Copper Grate
fixtures.examineDescription: The grate is scored from years of honest work. Sand waits beside it. A slate says: 'Name the fire before you feed it.'
